info.title: Patreon API v2
info.description:
OpenAPI 3.1 specification for the Patreon API v2, split into subfiles using JSON `$ref` references.

## What's new in v2 vs v1

| Change | Details |
|--------|----------|
| **Members replace Pledges** | The `Member` resource replaces the v1 `Pledge`. Members return richer data including charge status and membership lifetime. |
| **Explicit fields required** | No attributes or relationships are returned by default. All desired fields must be requested via `fields[{type}]=...` |
| **Improved scopes** | Finer-grained OAuth scopes for better security and developer control. |
| **Webhook management** | Clients can create and manage webhooks on campaigns on behalf of creators. |
| **Cursor pagination** | Member and post endpoints use cursor-based pagination via `page[cursor]`. |

## Authentication

All requests require an OAuth 2.0 Bearer token. Complete the authorization flow:
1. Redirect user to `GET https://www.patreon.com/oauth2/authorize`
2. Exchange the authorization code: `POST /api/oauth2/token`
3. Include `Authorization: Bearer {access_token}` on all API requests.

## OAuth Scopes

| Scope | Access granted |
|-------|----------------|
| `identity` | User public profile |
| `identity[email]` | User email address |
| `identity.memberships` | User's own memberships |
| `campaigns` | Campaign data |
| `w:campaigns.webhook` | Create/manage webhooks |
| `campaigns.members` | Campaign member data |
| `campaigns.members[email]` | Member email |
| `campaigns.members.address` | Member shipping address |
| `campaigns.posts` | Campaign posts |

## Requesting Fields

All attributes must be explicitly requested. URL-encode square brackets:

```
GET /api/oauth2/v2/campaigns?fields%5Bcampaign%5D=patron_count,is_monthly
```

## Cursor Pagination

Use `meta.pagination.cursors.next` from a response as the `page[cursor]` parameter to fetch the next page. A null `next` cursor means no further pages.

## Rate Limits

Rate-limited at both client and token level. HTTP 429 responses include `retry_after_seconds`. Refreshing a token does **not** reset rate limits. After 2,000+ bad requests in 10 minutes, a 30-minute block is applied.

## Directory structure

```
openapi.json                          ← root entry point
components/
  schemas/          (19 files)         ← Error, User, Campaign, Member, Tier, Benefit,
  |                                       Address, Post, Webhook, Goal, PaginationMeta,
  |                                       ResourceLinkage, Relationship, JSON:API envelopes
  parameters/       (4 files)           ← fields, include, page[cursor], page[count]
  responses/        (7 files)           ← shared HTTP error responses
  securitySchemes/  (2 files)           ← OAuth2, BearerToken
paths/
  oauth/            (2 files)           ← token exchange + refresh
  identity/         (1 file)            ← GET /identity
  campaigns/        (4 files)           ← campaigns list, single, members, posts
  members/          (1 file)            ← GET /members/{id}
  posts/            (1 file)            ← GET /posts/{id}
  webhooks/         (2 files)           ← webhook CRUD
```

tags.name: OAuth
tags.description: OAuth 2.0 token exchange and refresh. No authentication required on these endpoints.

tags.name: Identity
tags.description: Fetch data about the current authenticated user via their OAuth token.

tags.name: Campaigns
tags.description: Access campaign data — list, single campaign, campaign members, and campaign posts.

tags.name: Members
tags.description: Access individual member records. Members replace v1 Pledges and provide richer data about patron relationships.

tags.name: Posts
tags.description: Access individual post records on campaigns.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Manage webhooks for real-time campaign event delivery. Supports member lifecycle events and post events.
